graphics_processor.title: Monolithic GPU Compute Die
graphics_processor.description: High-transistor-density silicon micro-architecture core executing thousands of parallel compute threads for real-time graphics rendering and tensor computation.

vram_modules.title: GDDR6X Video Memory Modules
vram_modules.description: Eight high-speed BGA memory chips utilizing PAM4 multi-level signaling to deliver over 1 TB/s of dedicated frame-buffer memory bandwidth.

vrm_power_stages.title: 16-Phase DrMOS Voltage Regulator
vrm_power_stages.description: Multi-phase digital power delivery system with monolithic smart power stages (DrMOS) and alloy chokes supplying clean low-ripple voltage to the GPU core.

pcb_board.title: 12-Layer High-Density FR4 PCB
pcb_board.description: Custom multi-layer server-grade printed circuit board with 2oz copper ground planes, ultra-dense trace routing, and back-drilled via holes.

vapor_chamber_base.title: Copper Vapor Chamber & Heatpipes
vapor_chamber_base.description: Nickel-plated copper planar vacuum chamber paired with six composite sintered heatpipes spreading localized thermal flux rapidly across the fin matrix.

heatsink_fin_array.title: Dual High-Density Aluminum Fin Stack
heatsink_fin_array.description: Wave-contoured aluminum cooling fin arrays engineered to maximize boundary-layer air turbulence while minimizing aerodynamic fan noise.

triple_fans.title: Triple 90mm Axial Cooling Fans
triple_fans.description: Fluid-dynamic bearing axial fans featuring alternate counter-rotation to eliminate airflow turbulence and push pressurized air through the heatsink.

cooler_shroud.title: Die-Cast Metal Cooler Shroud
cooler_shroud.description: Precision die-cast aluminum outer armor directing airflow across the heatsink fins while shielding internal components from physical damage.

backplate.title: Brushed Aluminum Backplate
backplate.description: Full-coverage structural aluminum backplate preventing PCB sagging and featuring a flow-through exhaust window for pass-through chassis ventilation.

io_bracket.title: Dual-Slot Stainless Steel I/O Bracket
io_bracket.description: Anti-corrosion stainless steel bracket anchoring the card to the PC chassis and providing precision cutouts for display video outputs.

pcie_interface.title: PCIe 5.0 ×16 Gold Interface
pcie_interface.description: Standardized 16-lane high-speed differential bus edge connector with hard gold-plated contact fingers delivering up to 64 GB/s bidirectional throughput.

power_connector.title: 16-Pin 12V-2x6 (12VHPWR) Power Socket
power_connector.description: High-density 12V DC power connector featuring 12 primary power conductors and 4 top sense pins capable of safely delivering up to 600W.

thermal_pads.title: High-Conductivity Thermal Gap Pads
thermal_pads.description: Compressible silicone-based thermal pads bridging the mechanical tolerance gap between VRAM/VRM components and the vapor chamber.

display_outputs.title: DisplayPort 2.1 & HDMI 2.1a Outputs
display_outputs.description: Full array of video output ports supporting multi-monitor high-refresh 4K and 8K HDR displays with DSC compression.
